# Leonardo

> > Leonardo is a global aerospace, defence, and security company providing advanced technologies across aeronautics, cyber security, electronics, space, and helicopters.

Leonardo is a major defence and aerospace contractor with divisions spanning aeronautics, cybersecurity, electronics, and space systems. The site serves investors, media, and stakeholders with financial information, press releases, and divisional product details.

## Key Topics

- Aerospace & Defence
- Industrial Plan 2026
- Aeronautics Division
- Cyber & Security
- Helicopters
- Electronics
- Space Systems

- Press Releases
- Financial Results
- AW149 Aircraft
- Uncrewed Systems
- Cybersecurity Solutions
- Strategic Growth
- Global Operations

## Company Overview

- [Aerospace, Defence and Security | Leonardo](https://www.leonardo.com/en): Leonardo's homepage showcasing aerospace, defence, security divisions

## Business Divisions

- [Leonardo Aeronautics: Aerostructures, Aircraft and Uncrewed Systems](https://aeronautics.leonardo.com/en): Aeronautics division showcasing aircraft, aerostructures and drones
- [Professional Cyber and Security Governance Services](https://cybersecurity.leonardo.com/en): Cyber & Security division offering governance and resilience solutions
